   721  /************************************************************************/
   722  /*                              pj_free()                               */
   723  /*                                                                      */
   724  /*      This is the application callable entry point for destroying     */
   725  /*      a projection definition.  It does work generic to all           */
   726  /*      projection types, and then calls the projection specific        */
   727  /*      free function (P->pfree()) to do local work.  In most cases     */
   728  /*      P->pfree()==pj_default_destructor.                              */
   729  /************************************************************************/
   730
   731  void pj_free(PJ *P) {
   732      if (0==P)
   733          return;
   734      /* free projection parameters - all the hard work is done by */
   735      /* pj_default_destructor (in pj_malloc.c), which is supposed */
   736      /* to be called as the last step of the local destructor     */
   737      /* pointed to by P->destructor. In most cases,               */
   738      /* pj_default_destructor actually *is* what is pointed to    */
   739      P->destructor (P, 0);
   740  }
